facts.statement: The genus Brachydeirus was first described by Koenen in 1880.
facts.quote: authority: Koenen, 1880

facts.statement: Brachydeirus has been known by the synonyms Brachydirus, Anomalichthys (in part), and Auchenosteus.
facts.quote: synonyms: Brachydirus Gross, 1932 Anomalichthys (in part) Koenen, 1883 Auchenosteus Jaekel, 1911

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Brachydeirus is Brachydeirus carinatus.
facts.quote: type_species: Brachydeirus carinatus

facts.statement: Six species are recognized within the genus Brachydeirus: B. bicarinatus, B. carinatus, B. gracilis, B. grandis, B. magnus, and B. minor.
facts.quote: subdivision: B. bicarinatus Stensio, 1963 B. carinatus Gross, 1932 B. gracilis Gross, 1932 B. grandis Gross, 1932 B. magnus Gross, 1933 B. minor Gross, 1932

facts.statement: Brachydeirus was a small to moderately large arthrodire placoderm that lived in Europe during the Late Devonian.
facts.quote: Brachydeirus is a genus of small to moderately large-sized arthrodire placoderms from the Late Devonian of Europe

facts.statement: Fossils of Brachydeirus are restricted to the Kellwasserkalk Fauna found at Bad Wildungen and Adorf.
facts.quote: restricted to the Kellwasserkalk Fauna of Bad Wildungen and Adorf

facts.statement: Living Brachydeirus animals would have looked superficially like modern trout or small mackerels.
facts.quote: The living animals would have superficially resembled modern-day trout or small mackerels

facts.statement: Brachydeirus species had a highly compressed body in cross-section, a pointed snout, and very large orbits.
facts.quote: Species have, in cross section, a highly compressed body, a pointed, sometimes highly elongated snout, and tremendous orbits

facts.statement: Brachydeirus is distinguished by a median dorsal plate on its trunk shield that is often keeled with a high, prominent ridge.
facts.quote: The genus is distinguished from other members of the family in that the median dorsal plate of the trunk shield is often keeled, with the keel often very high and prominent

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Brachydeirus carinatus measures 11.7 cm in length.
facts.quote: The length of the skull of the holotype is 11.7 cm

facts.statement: Brachydeirus carinatus has a broad nuchal plate that curves outward at the back.
facts.quote: Has a broad nuchal plate that is convex posteriorly

facts.statement: The dermal bones of Brachydeirus carinatus are decorated with large tubercles arranged in concentric circles.
facts.quote: The dermal bones are decorated with large, concentrically arranged tubercles

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Brachydeirus bicarinatus is 8.5 cm long.
facts.quote: The skull of the holotype is 8.5 cm long

facts.statement: Brachydeirus gracilis is the smallest species in the genus, with a holotype skull length of 6 cm.
facts.quote: The smallest species in this genus: the skull length of the holotype is 6 cm

facts.statement: Brachydeirus gracilis differs from B. minor by having a steeper back, smaller facial plates, and no postpineal fenestra.
facts.quote: Differs from B. minor by having a more steeply arched back, smaller facial plates and a lack of a postpineal fenestra

facts.statement: Brachydeirus grandis is one of the largest species in the genus, with a holotype skull length of around 20 cm.
facts.quote: One of the largest species in this genus: the skull length of the holotype is around 20 cm

facts.statement: Brachydeirus grandis has a postpineal fenestra, an unusually long lateral trunk shield, and relatively small orbits.
facts.quote: Has a postpineal fenestra, an unusually long (for the genus/family) lateral trunk shield, and comparatively small orbits

facts.statement: The dermal bones of Brachydeirus grandis are decorated with small, evenly spaced tubercles.
facts.quote: The dermal bones are decorated with a pattern of small, evenly spaced tubercles

facts.statement: Brachydeirus magnus is a very large species that was originally described as a specimen of Anomalichthys.
facts.quote: A very large species originally described as a specimen of Anomalichthys

facts.statement: The dermal surface of Brachydeirus magnus is covered in very large tubercles.
facts.quote: and the dermal surface is covered in very large tubercles

facts.statement: Brachydeirus minor is a small species with a holotype skull length of 7.4 cm.
facts.quote: Another small species: the skull length of the holotype is 7.4 cm long

facts.statement: Brachydeirus lived during the Frasnian stage, between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Frasnian to Frasnian (382.31 to 372.15 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of the genus Brachydeirus is the family Brachydeiridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Brachydeiridae

facts.statement: Brachydeirus belongs to the class Placodermi.
facts.quote: Class: Placodermi
